difficultyRationale: Checks how line terminators are handled by the NIO.2 convenience methods, in particular that a trailing newline does not produce an extra empty line.

{{snippet}}

explanation: Files.readAllLines splits the content into lines using line terminators. A final terminator ends the last line; it does not start a new, empty one. The text alpha, newline, beta, newline therefore contains two lines.

options.explanation: The trailing newline terminates the line beta and does not create a third, empty line.
A third element would appear only if there were text after the last line terminator, for example a blank line.
The method recognises every line terminator, not just the last one, so the two lines are returned separately.

options.text: It throws an exception because the file was not closed.
options.explanation: readAllLines opens and closes the file itself. The code only needs to handle the IOException it may throw.
